title: Thread history answers and errors are matched by origin chat+message, not by the RequestId held in ThreadStatus::LoadingHistory
trigger: Open a thread; while its first page (LoadingHistory(r)) is in flight, an older/newer page of the same origin (or a re-sent page) lands or fails
effect: Any matching page flips LoadingHistory(r) to Ready, or any matching failure (incl. an older/newer page, or a getMessageThread re-resolve) flips it to Failed, while request r is still out; the thread shows empty/Failed then fills in or sticks
fix: Compare the answer's RequestId with LoadingHistory(r) (grep shows nothing but connect/threads.rs reads it); other pages go through the history's own older/newer stage

title: begin_thread replaces the ThreadView whole, so stale_pages of the old view is lost and in-flight pages of the old opening land in the new view of the same origin
trigger: Open comments of post P, close, reopen P before the first page answered
effect: The old opening's page (different window/anchor) is applied to the new view whose thread_id/root_ids are not resolved yet; rows or completion flags from the wrong window
fix: Give each ThreadView an opening token carried by its requests (like WindowViews::openings), match answers to it

title: leave_open_chat closes the thread only when thread.chat_id == prev, not when thread.origin_chat_id == prev
trigger: Open a channel post's comments (status SwitchingChat, thread.chat_id = discussion group, open chat still the channel), then move the channel to its own window
effect: The main window's thread survives with open = None and later runs switch_to_thread_chat, opening the discussion group in the main window the user just emptied
fix: Close the thread when either its chat or its origin is the chat left (one OwnedBy check)

title: begin_sponsored_hide resets sponsored_report to Idle by hand, dropping a report flow in flight (Asking or Picking)
trigger: Start reporting ad A (picker open or request out), then choose Hide ads on ad B
effect: The report picker/flow of A vanishes without Cancel or an answer; accept_sponsored_hidden was fixed to keep it (13-034) but this reset still overwrites it
fix: Only reset from the flow's own transitions: leave Asking/Picking alone as accept_sponsored_hidden does

title: baseline: RowForum::loaded
fix: Derive from a topics Fetch (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of contains_key || forum_topics_failed

title: recent_inline_bots: Option is the 'fetched' flag, with no Failed or Loading stage
trigger: Type '@' in a composer while getRecentInlineBots fails
effect: None means both 'never asked' and 'failed'; the in-flight check is a scan of pending by purpose (connect/bots.rs maybe_fetch_recent_inline_bots); the error is not recorded, so each '@' re-asks
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> with the request in Loading

title: send_as_options Fetch::Loading { request: None }: the stage never holds the request, and the answer inserts Ready by chat id
trigger: Open the send-as picker in a chat, close it and reopen (or an update races the answer)
effect: Answer (domains/messages/apply.rs:44) and error (error.rs:133) are matched by purpose + chat id, one-in-flight guarded only by a pending scan; a Retry answer of an older request is taken as current
fix: Store the RequestId in Loading and use Fetch::answered(request, ..) for the answer and error

title: needs_translation treats Failed as 'no translation needed', so an automatic pump never retries a failed message
trigger: Translate a chat automatically, one translateMessageText fails (error, 'lost', 'send')
effect: The row shows 'translation error' for good; only an edit of the message (forget_message_translations) or a manual send clears it
fix: Failed with a retry mark/backoff, or a retry action on the failed row

title: TranslateState::messages is never pruned with chat history or the chat leaving the kept set
trigger: Read many translated chats in one session
effect: Done translations (text and entities) of every message in every language stay for the life of the session, beyond the history they belong to
fix: Drop a chat's entries in history_prune / release_chat_history

title: Batch progress is four hand-kept fields (batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed, batch_pending) plus the requests in flight
trigger: Batch install/archive several sets, switch account or lose a request without an answer
effect: batch_pending only shrinks on an answer or send failure; a dropped request leaves the batch counted as pending and the totals never settle
fix: One BatchStage { Idle, Running { pending: Vec<(set, RequestId)>, done, failed } }

title: archived/trending paging reads archived_offset/trending_offset written at send time, not the offset the answered request carried
trigger: Page archived or trending sets, a refetch (updateTrendingStickerSets) is sent while the earlier page is out
effect: accept_* decides replace-or-append from the offset of the latest send, so an answer can replace or append to the wrong page; single-flight (has_purpose) is the only guard
fix: Carry the offset in the request (RequestPurpose) or a Fetch Loading { request, offset }

title: date_jump_pending (Option tuple) and chat_search.jump (Loading{message_id}) must change together and are cleared by hand in five places
trigger: Start a date jump, then pick a search hit, or delete the message the jump waits for (miss_search_jump sets Missing but not date_jump_pending)
effect: The pending date jump outlives its jump; a later load-around of the same message id resolves with the old mode and retargets the view
fix: Put the mode in ChatSearchJump::Loading { message_id, then: DateJumpMode }

title: SavedPage { Idle, Asking(RequestId) } sits beside TopicHistory's own older-end stage for the same page
trigger: Page a Saved Messages sublist or tag filter and fail a page
effect: Failure sets page = Idle and history.fail_older() by hand in three places (fail_saved_tag_page, fail_saved_topic_page, awaiting_saved_tag_search); two values for one stage
fix: Take the request from the history's older-end stage (OlderEnd::Asking(RequestId)) and drop SavedPage

title: fail_story_report_send replaces the whole report flow, also one that belongs to another story
trigger: Report story A (Checking), switch to story B and a send of B fails
effect: A's flow is overwritten by B's Failed; A's answer is then dropped as unmatched
fix: Fail only when the current flow is for chat_id/story_id; otherwise ignore

title: An opener thread that ends leaves its decoded clips Opening forever
trigger: A video sticker (WebM) is decoding on an opener thread and the decode closure panics (spawn_guarded catches it and the thread exits), or every opener thread has ended
effect: The sticker never gets a first frame; its UiClip stays Opening::Pending, and views waiting on the first frame keep animating (ticking) with no way out until the clip goes stale and is closed. WorkerEnd(.., None) only sets worker_gone and never fails clips in Stage::Opening, nor Stage::Waiting(Origin::Decoded) once no opener runs (workers_decode stays false)
fix: Track opener threads as WorkerLife too; when an opener ends, fail the clip it held (Stage::Opening for Decoded) and when none run, fail Waiting(Decoded) clips or flip workers_decode; drop worker_gone for the per-thread lives

title: Clip::delivered is a one-way 'first frame handed out' latch beside Stage
trigger: A clip draws its first frame, then Failed or re-opened
effect: The first-frame wake (worker::frame returns true) hangs on a bool flipped with mem::replace, outside the stage that decides when a clip is Ready
fix: Stage::Ready{info, delivered: Delivered} or a Drawing/Ready variant that carries the first-frame mark

title: searchWebApp answer is matched to the waiting flow by bot id, not by the RequestId
trigger: Click two t.me/<bot>/<app1> and t.me/<bot>/<app2> links of the same bot before the first searchWebApp answers
effect: The first answer (app1's FoundWebApp, skip_confirmation, request_write_access) is taken by the flow now waiting for app2 (take_search_for compares bot_id only), so app2 is launched or consented to with app1's terms; the second answer finds no flow and is dropped
fix: WebApps::found: Option<(RequestId, Result<..>)> and Searching { request: RequestId, awaited } matched on the request

title: WebApps::pending is a Vec that never holds more than one launch
trigger: Any open call: mark_web_app_pending clears the Vec before pushing
effect: The doc says 'a second launch keeps its own context' but the only writer clears first, so the collection hides a one-slot stage; readers loop over a list that cannot have two
fix: Option<WebAppPending> (or a keyed map if concurrent launches are meant)

title: Custom-method replies carry only the app's req_id and go to whichever mini app window is current
trigger: A mini app sends web_app_invoke_custom_method, is closed (or the window is replaced by another app) before TDLib answers
effect: poll_mini_app_session emits the reply into self.mini_apps.window with the old req_id; a different app that uses the same req_id gets another app's result; custom_requests entries whose answer never comes are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight entry by RequestId with the launch/window it was sent for, and drop the answer (and the entry) when that launch is gone

title: data_sent is an unkeyed one-shot slot taken by whichever poll runs next
trigger: Two keyboard-button mini apps send data close together, or the account is switched away before the answer and back later
effect: The second answer overwrites the first (one 'Sent to the bot' note for two sends, or a failure lost), and an answer that lands while another account is on screen shows its note when this account returns
fix: A per-request outcome keyed by RequestId, taken by the flow that sent it, and cleared in the account's Farewell

title: Reported is a two-variant enum that is a bool for 'rows were reported'
trigger: Open a history, then scroll: restart() sets Unreported, report() sets Reported, restart_reported() sets it directly
effect: The book's phase is a flag beside the per-message stages that abort() and the newest-row rule branch on; it is changed from three methods, not from stage transitions
fix: Fold into the stage: ViewBook as enum { Newest(stages), Reported(stages, on_screen) } so on_screen only exists once reported

title: FramePlan keeps base and last as two Options set together, last doubling as a started flag
trigger: Any WebM sticker decode: place() sets base on the first call and last on the first taken picture; tail() reads last.is_none() as 'nothing taken'
effect: base/last/emitted must change in step; a change to place() that sets one without the other skews every slot
fix: enum FramePlan { Empty, Running { base: i64, last: i64, emitted: usize } }

title: A failed load of the bundled sticker decoder is cached for the whole process
trigger: First video sticker is decoded while quillvideo is missing, still being installed or fails to load once
effect: Api::load's Err sits in the OnceLock forever: every WebM sticker then uses the ffmpeg fallback (or fails with 'Video stickers need the bundled decoder' without the ui feature) until restart, even after the library appears
fix: Cache only success (OnceLock<Api>) and retry the lookup after a failure, or hold Loaded/Unavailable{since} in a Mutex

title: StoryComposer::open bool beside an always-present Box<StoryComposer> and its stage
trigger: Open the story composer, press Post (stage Posting), close the composer, reopen it
effect: No bug today (close() replaces the whole value, and answers are matched by RequestId), but 'open' is an Option-as-flag: a closed composer still carries a live-looking stage, media and mode, and every reader must test open first (esc_stack, render, click-through)
fix: StoryUi::composer: Option<Box<StoryComposer>> (or a Composer { Closed, Open(StoryComposer) } enum) so closed has no stage

title: Composer link_url / reaction_emojis mirror TextareaState inputs synced by hand before posting; mode and as_chat_id are separate bare-id fields
trigger: Edit the link or emoji field then post/save; or open Edit/Repost with as_chat_id set from a previous poster
effect: Two copies of the same text (struct string and input entity) must be copied in step; ComposerMode::Repost/Edit(i64,i32) and as_chat_id: Option<i64> are bare chat ids that must agree with each other and the account
fix: read the text from the inputs at send time only (drop the mirrors); fold as_chat_id into ComposerMode with OfAccount/ChatId owner keys

title: CloseFriendsStage::Loading/Failed carry no RequestId and shadow CloseFriendsList::Loading/Failed in the session
trigger: Open the close-friends editor, let getCloseFriends fail, press Retry; or open it while another load is in flight
effect: No bug today, but the load stage lives twice (viewer panel stage and Session::stories::close_friends). The panel stage leaves Loading only when the UI tick reads failed_without_list() or a list from the session, instead of by the answer to its own request; with no live driver (demo) Loading has no way out but Cancel
fix: derive the panel's Loading/Failed from CloseFriendsList (single owner), keeping only Editing/Saving{request} in the panel stage

title: StoryPageOp keyed by bare Option<i64> chat id and a free-text label; finished ops linger until a caller settles them by hand
trigger: Run an album mutation, leave the page without the owner calling settle_story_page_op/leave_story_page; or have more than 64 ops in flight
effect: Succeeded/Failed ops stay in the list until settle_finished/forget_chat is called from outside their own transitions; loading() matches reads by label string; begin() past the cap with no finished op grows the Vec without bound
fix: op identity = RequestId + typed StoryPageOpKind (not a label string), owner ChatId; finished ops expire in their own transition (Succeeded/Failed with a deadline) instead of caller-driven settle

title: One-shot notes and balance_low queues are drained from render (status_toast_visible) with no lock or owner check
trigger: Approve/decline/offer fails (or BALANCE_TOO_LOW) while the app is locked or the account is not the live one, then unlock or switch back
effect: The error toast (and the top-up box from ask_after_balance_error) appears late or while locked; the Vec has no cap if nothing drains it; the draining is a state mutation inside a render path
fix: push the failure into the window/account notice queue at the error arm (owner-scoped, refused_while_locked), no Vec the render drains

title: ParsedGroupCallParticipant still stores video_enabled/screen_sharing_enabled beside video_info/screen_sharing_video_info (section 8 06-043 says they derive)
trigger: Any code that builds a participant (screen_chooser_demo.rs:187 sets video_enabled: !me with video_info: None) or edits one field
effect: Readers (group_call_tiles.rs:109-147, group_call_members.rs:262) read the bool while the engine subscribes from the Option; the two can disagree and a tile is drawn with no endpoint or the reverse
fix: Drop the two bools and make them methods: video_info.is_some() and screen_sharing_video_info.is_some()

title: ParsedCall::ready is Some only while state is CallState::Ready, kept in step at parse time (section 8 06-042 moved the session's CallState to Ready(ReadyParams) but the wire type did not)
trigger: Build or edit a ParsedCall by hand (tests, a future producer): state Ready with ready None, or ready Some with state Pending
effect: session_calls.rs:39-43,116 copies call.ready into the active call independent of call.state; a mismatch gives a Ready call with no key or a key on a pending call
fix: CallState::Ready(ReadyParams) on the envelope type; delete ParsedCall::ready

title: baseline: ParsedGroupCall::loaded_all_participants (TDLib's own report; the ActiveGroupCall twin is in the allow list, this one is not)
trigger: none today; copied into the tracked call at session_calls.rs:610
effect: none; baseline debt stays on the register
fix: Add ParsedGroupCall::loaded_all_participants to implicit-state-allow.txt with the same reason as ActiveGroupCall, then drop it from the baseline

title: AccentRead::Failed is final: a read that found no accent (portal says no preference, or gdbus not ready at startup) is never retried
trigger: Linux: start Quill while the desktop has no accent or the session bus is not up yet, then set an accent in system settings and open Appearance
effect: The 'use system accent' option stays hidden/unavailable until restart; refresh() returns at the Idle check so the new accent is never read
fix: Failed{last, retry_after} (or back to Idle after the failed read) so a later refresh() from a settings open or window focus can read again

title: System proxy follow runs for the on-screen account only; background accounts using system proxy mode never get their hidden entry planned or re-read, and WANTED is one process-wide flag set by whichever account ticks
trigger: Two accounts, background one in 'Use system proxy settings' mode; the OS proxy changes or the network returns while the other account is on screen
effect: The background account keeps a stale or missing system proxy entry in TDLib (connecting direct or through the old proxy) until it is switched to; connect/ticks.rs:79-95 returns before reread_system_proxy/system_proxy_tick for TickScope::Background
fix: Move reread_system_proxy and system_proxy_tick above the Background early return and make WANTED a count/set of accounts (or a per-driver flag the reader consults)

title: KeyboardButtonType::RequestPoll keeps force_regular and force_quiz as two bools; both true is representable and resolved by precedence in QuizLock::from_button
trigger: A bot keyboard with both flags set (malformed or future payload) is parsed as-is; the consumer picks quiz over regular
effect: None today; the contradictory pair is carried to the UI and silently resolved there
fix: enum PollRequest { Any, RegularOnly, QuizOnly } built once in the parser

title: Thumbnail kind is a bool (thumb_still) beside Option<FileId> thumb_file_id; the pair must agree (still vs MP4 preview clip), and thumb_still defaults to true when there is no thumbnail
trigger: Any animation/video/GIF with an MPEG-4 thumbnail; a producer that sets thumb_file_id without thumb_still (or the reverse) draws a clip as an image
effect: None today; AnimationItem derives still_thumb/preview_clip from the pair, AnimationContent and VideoContent carry the same pair with no such accessor
fix: enum Thumb { None, Still(FileId), Clip(FileId) } with width/height inside the variants

title: InlineQueryResultsButton is a stringly sum type: kind String ('start_bot'/'web_app'/'unknown') with parameter and url valid only for one kind, kept in step by hand
trigger: A consumer reads url for a start_bot button or parameter for a web_app button, or matches on a misspelled kind string
effect: None today; the empty-string convention is the only guard (the same shape holds for InlineQueryResultSummary::kind)
fix: enum InlineQueryResultsButtonKind { StartBot { parameter }, WebApp { url }, Unknown } and an enum for the result kind

title: DiceContent says whether the roll is known three ways: value<=0, landing None, and initial None; result_line/label read value while animation()/DicePhase reads landing
trigger: A messageDice with value > 0 but final_state absent or its stickers missing (slot machine missing one of five stickers parses to None)
effect: The label/accessibility line shows the rolled number while the bubble keeps looping the rolling animation; or the reverse when value is 0 but final_state is present
fix: enum DiceState { Rolling { initial }, Landed { value, landing: Option<DiceStickers> } } so the value and the animation are one stage

title: PaymentReceiptData keeps `is_stars: bool` beside fields that only apply to one receipt kind
trigger: Open a Stars receipt: currency, total_amount, credentials_title and tip_amount are empty/zero placeholders and star_count is the real value; a regular receipt leaves star_count 0. Every reader (src/ui/payments/build_payment_dialog.rs:164) must branch on the bool to pick the right fields.
effect: No bug today; a reader that forgets the bool shows an empty price or 0 stars.
fix: enum PaymentReceiptKind { Regular { currency, total_amount, credentials_title, tip_amount }, Stars { star_count } } (the TDLib paymentReceiptType* split)

title: messageGift star total adds two TDLib int64 values unchecked (base + upgrade)
trigger: A messageGift whose gift.star_count plus prepaid_upgrade_star_count exceeds i64::MAX (malformed or hostile payload)
effect: Debug build panics on overflow; release wraps to a negative star price shown in the service line
fix: base.saturating_add(upgrade) (panic-safety rule 5)

title: StoryContentView::Video::file_id uses FileId(0) as 'no clip' while thumb_file_id uses Option
trigger: storyContentVideo whose video file fails to parse
effect: No bug today: story_viewer.rs:459-469 and session paths re-check file_id.0 != 0 by hand; a new reader that forgets the check would request download of file 0
fix: file_id: Option<FileId> like thumb_file_id
